items.t: Nintendo Announces Black Friday Offers to Help Spread Joy This Holiday Season
items.sum: REDMOND, Wash., November 12, 2026--The holidays are almost here, and Nintendo has Black Friday offers with a range of options for holiday shoppers. With holiday specials featuring the Nintendo Switch 2 system and games for both Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch, there are more ways than ever to create lasting memories and connect with family and friends during this special time of year.

items.t: Zelda remake becomes fastest-selling Nintendo Switch 2 game ever
items.sum: Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa reports on "The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time" selling 5.2 million copies in its first four days on Nintendo (NTDOY) Switch 2, the device's fastest-selling game ever, ahead of next week's Grand Theft Auto 6 launch.

items.t: Nintendo's Zelda remake sells 5.2M copies in just four days
items.sum: Nintendo (NTDOY) 'Ocarina of Time' remake is reportedly off to a record-breaking start, selling 5.2 million copies in just four days and setting a new launch sales record for the Switch 2. The 8:30 hosts, Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley, react to the launch of the highly anticipated Zelda remake.

items.t: Nintendo: Down 42% But Still Not A Buy (Rating Downgrade)
Why Nintendo Stock Is One to Watch Ahead of the Holiday Season
items.sum: Nintendo stock faces a critical holiday season as slowing Switch 2 sales and new Zelda demand test its recovery.
